priorityList: Pre-combat: Ensure Devotion Aura, Rite of Sanctification, and Rite of Adjuration are active.
Cast Avenging Wrath when Divine Toll is ready or will be available within 10 seconds.
Use Divine Toll while Avenging Wrath is active.
Cast Hammer of Light if the target has the Judgment debuff and Hammer of Light is expiring or Undisputed Ruling is missing.
Spend Holy Power on Shield of the Righteous if Hammer of Light is not ready, or if you have a free proc.
Use Holy Armaments to maintain Sacred Weapon uptime (buff remaining < 6 seconds).
Cast Hammer of Wrath or Judgment if Hammer of Light is ready but the target lacks the Judgment debuff.
Cast Avenger's Shield when Vanguard is active or during Avenging Wrath with Apex procs.
Use Holy Armaments to cycle through Holy Bulwark if Avenging Wrath is nearly ready or if you have 2 charges.
Cast Consecration if you reach 5 stacks of Divine Guidance.
Cast Hammer of Wrath as your priority generator.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and maintain high uptime on the debuff.
Cast Avenger's Shield as a standard generator.
Use Blessed Hammer (or Hammer of the Righteous) if the Blessed Assurance buff is active.
Maintain Consecration and use free Word of Glory procs from Shining Light.
